title: 菲兹·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 宽阔蓝色水生头部带着金色双眼，鳍状双耳呼应蹼状手足。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Fizz is a small amphibious yordle with smooth blue skin, a broad aquatic head, large golden eyes, fin-like ears, webbed hands and feet, and a compact nonhuman body. Preserve his natural species proportions without enlarging the head into a mascot or turning him into a human child. His characteristic waist garment is opaque, and his long three-pronged trident rests upright at his side.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: turquoise, golden eyes, slate sea, warm sand; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
